description:
Create a GitFlow branching strategy diagram in draw.io that visually documents the release cycle described in '~/Desktop/release_scenario.txt'.

Your task:
1. Open draw.io (Diagrams.net).
2. Read the scenario in '~/Desktop/release_scenario.txt'.
3. Create a diagram showing the timeline, branches, commits, merges, and tags exactly as described.
4. Use the specific colors requested in the scenario (Blue for main, Green for develop, etc.).
5. Save the source file to '~/Diagrams/gitflow_release.drawio'.
6. Export the final diagram as a PNG image to '~/Diagrams/gitflow_release.png'.

The diagram must include:
- All 7 branches (main, develop, 3 features, 1 release, 1 hotfix)
- Correct hierarchy/parallelism (time flows left-to-right)
- Labeled commits and version tags
- Proper merge arrows
